original: nanv evaṃ caturdaśyāṃ somadarśanāc caturdaśītaḥ paratra dine ’nvādhānaṃ kartavyam iti caturdaśīgrahaṇasyobhayatra sambandhād vākyabhedaś caturdaśīta iti vipariṇāmakalpanā ca syāt |

original: ucyate | yadi vyavahitakalpanādibhayād anvādhānāpakarṣavidhānam āśrīyate tarhi tavāpi kiyanto doṣāḥ prasajyante tad ākarṇyatāṃ | [358] tathā hi tatra hi pakṣe somadarśanād iti kva sambadhyate, kiṃ caturdaśyāṃ somadarśanād iti, kiṃ vā caturdaśītaḥ paratra dina iti, kiṃ vāmāvāsyāyāḥ parataḥ pratipadi, kiṃ vā parataḥ parasyāṃ diśi somadarśanād iti, na tāvac caturdaśyāṃ somadarśanād iti, sarvato ’sammatatvād evaṃvidhānvayasya somadarśanasya doṣatveneṣṭatvāc ca | kathaṃ tadvaty eva dine ’nvādhānaṃ vidhīyate | nāpi caturdaśyāḥ paratra dine somadarśanād iti, anvādhānayogyacaturdaśītaḥ paratra dine kadācit somadarśanābhāvāt | nāpi pratipadi somadarśanād iti, tathā sati parātparataḥ somadarśanād ity ucyeta na punaḥ parataḥ somadarśanād iti | atha lakṣaṇayā sa evārthaḥ parata ity anenocyate, tarhi lakṣaṇaiva doṣaḥ | atha pratipad api caturdaśītaḥ parā bhavatīti parata ity anena mukhyayaiva vṛttyā pratipad ucyate, tarhi pañcamyāṃ somadarśanād api caturdaśyām anvādhānaṃ vidhīyeta | atha pratipady āparāhṇikīty atra sākṣād upāttena pratipadīty anena sambandhaṃ kṛtvā pratipadi somadarśanād ity ucyate, tathā sati pratipacchabdasya dvitīyāśabdena somadarśanena ca sambandhād vākyabhedo vyavahitakalpanā ca parataḥśabdo ’py anarthakaḥ prāpnoti | pratipadi ca kadācid api somadarśanābhāvād asaṃbhāvyam ānārthatvaṃ prāpnoti | atha "tad vaike dṛṣṭvopavasantīty upavāsadine somadarśanasya jñātatvena guṇatvam eva na doṣatvam iti caturdaśyām anvādhānaṃ kartavyaṃ caturdaśyāṃ somadarśanād iti yady ucyeta, tarhi caturdaśīgrahaṇasyānvādhānaṃ somadarśanād iti yadi vyākhyeyaṃ tataḥ kasminn ahanīti vaktavyam | na tāvac caturdaśyāṃ, parataḥ somo dṛśyate yena tatrānvādhānaṃ vidhīyeta | nāpy amāvāsyāyāṃ, parataḥ [359] somadarśanād iti, tasyātrānupāttatvād anvādhānayogyacaturdaśyanantarāyām amāvāsyāyāṃ somadarśanāsambhavāc ca | nāpi pratipadi parasyāṃ diśi somadarśanād iti, tatra pūrvavākyabhedavyavahitakalpanayoḥ prasaṅgāt | tatra niyamena parasyām eva diśi somadarśanaṃ bhavatīti parata ity etad api anuvādamātratvenāpravṛttiviśeṣakaraṃ prāpnoti | atha paurṇamāsīpratipannivṛttyarthaṃ parataḥ parasyāṃ diśi somadarśanād iti yady ucyeta, tad ayuktaṃ paurṇamāsīpratipady apy ahorātre parasyāṃ diśi somadarśanasya vidyamānatvāt | atha pratipadi parasyāṃ diśi pūrvarātre somadarśanād iti vā, pratipadi rekhāmātrasya darśanāt prathamadarśanād iti vā, śuklapratipadi somadarśanād iti vā kṛṣṇapratipannivṛttyarthaṃ vyākhyāyate |
analyzed: ucyate yadi vyavahita kalpanā ādi bhayāt anvādhāna apakarṣa vidhānam āśrīyate tarhi tava api kiyantaḥ doṣāḥ prasajyante tat ākarṇyatām tathā hi tatra hi pakṣe soma darśanāt iti kva sambadhyate kim caturdaśyām soma darśanāt iti kim vā caturdaśītaḥ paratra dine iti kim vā amāvāsyāyāḥ paratas pratipadi kim vā paratas parasyām diśi soma darśanāt iti na tāvat caturdaśyām soma darśanāt iti sarvatas sammata tvāt evaṃvidha anvayasya soma darśanasya doṣaḥ

original: naitad evaṃ | pūrvarātrādigrahaṇānām adhyāhāraprasaṅgāt śrutair eva padais tatra dravyalakṣaṇāprasaṅgād vā pūrvoktānām api doṣāṇāṃ tadavasthatvāc ca uttarayoḥ pakṣayoḥ parataḥ śabdānarthakyaprasaṅgāc ca śuklapratipadi kadācid api somadarśanābhāvenāsaṃgatārthatvaprasaṅgāc (?) ca | atha śukladvitīyāyāṃ somadarśanād ity ucyate
analyzed: na etat evam pūrvarātra ādi grahaṇānām adhyāhāra prasaṅgāt śrutaiḥ eva padaiḥ tatra dravya lakṣaṇa aprasaṅgāt vā pūrva uktānām api doṣāṇām tad avasthatvāt ca uttarayoḥ pakṣayoḥ paratas śabda ānarthakya prasaṅgāt ca śukla pratipadi kadācid api soma darśana abhāvena asaṃgata artha tva prasaṅgāt ca atha śukla dvitīyāyām soma darśanāt iti ucyate

original: tan na | ditīyāśabdena śukladvitīyālakṣaṇāprasaṅgāt prathamāntadvitīyāśabdasya saptamyantatayā vipariṇāmaprasaṅgāc ca| kiṃ caivaṃ saty anapekṣite ’pi viṣaye kadācid anvādhānāpakarṣaḥ prasajyeta tatra spaṣṭārthaṃ yaṃ kaścid eva vāram adhikṛtya tithikḷptir udāhriyate, ādityavāre udayāstamayavyāpinyām amāvāsyāyāṃ, somavāre udayāstamayavyāpinyāṃ pratipadi, maṅgalavāre udayāstamayavyāpinyāṃ ditīyāyāṃ somadarśanāc caturdaśyām anvādhānāpakarṣaḥ prasajyeta dvitīyāsomadarśanatvāviśeṣāt | atha pratipadi yā śukladvitīyā tasyāṃ somadarśanād ity ucyate |
analyzed: tat na ditīyā śabdena śukladvitīyā lakṣaṇā prasaṅgāt prathamā anta dvitīyā śabdasya saptamī anta tayā vipariṇāma prasaṅgāt ca kim ca evam sati an apekṣite viṣaye kadācid anvādhāna apakarṣaḥ prasajyeta tatra spaṣṭa artham yam kaścid eva vāram adhikṛtya tithi kḷptiḥ udāhriyate ādityavāre udaya astamaya vyāpinyām amāvāsyāyām somavāre udaya astamaya vyāpinyām pratipadi maṅgalavāre udaya astamaya vyāpinyām ditīyāyām soma darśanāt caturdaśyā

original: [360]        tan na | anantaraikadoṣavarjaṃ pūrvoktasarvadoṣāṇāṃ tadavasthatvāt prapipadi kadācid api dvitīyāsambhavād asambhāvyamānārthatvam apy uktaṃ syāt |

original: atha divaiva pratipady uktāyāṃ śukladvitīyāyāṃ somadarśanād ity ucyate |
analyzed: atha divā eva pratipadi uktāyām śukla dvitīyāyām soma darśanāt iti ucyate

analyzed: tat na anantara eka doṣa varjam pūrva ukta doṣāṇām anyatra api aparihārāt

original: atha trimuhūrttāyāṃ dvitīyāyāṃ somadarśanād ity ucyate |

original: tarhy eṣa tāvad eko doṣaḥ saṃkhyāśabdānāṃ nyūnādhikanivartkasvabhāvānāṃ nyūnamātranivarttakatvam iti kṣayamātranyūnatrimuhūrtāyāṃ [361] somadarśanāviśeṣe ’pi anvādhānānapakarṣaḥ prasajyeta |

original: naitad evaṃ | na hi kadācid api tithiḥ kevalapūrvāhṇasambandhinī vidyata iti, sarvathā aparāhṇasambandhitvāviśeṣeṇa vyāvṛttyabhāvena vyarthaviśeṣaṇatvaprasaṅgāt |

original: athāparāhṇikī dvitīyā yasmin dine vidyate tadīyasandhyādikāle somadarśanād ity ucyate |

original: atra kecid vivadante | sāṅgasya pradhānasya pūrvāhṇe eva kartavyatvād brāhmaṇatarpaṇasya cāṅgatvād viramya vyāpāre cāṅgapradhānavatyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ vidhinā pravartitatvāt tadvirodhaḥ | vārttikakāraiś ca yāvajjīvādhikaraṇe paurṇamāsyatiriktāharvyavacchedaparā śrutiḥ | "avyāptāv api tadvat syān na tv ihaivaṃ pratīyata" ity etatślokavyākhyāne uktaṃ, yadi tatrālpatvāt karmaṇaḥ pūrvāhṇacodanāvaśena paurṇamāsī na vyāpyate na kiṃcid duṣyatīti vadadbhir iṣṭisamāptir api pūrvāhṇe darśitā | tasmāt paurṇamāsyāṃ sadyaskālatvapakṣāṅgīkāre “pūrvāṃ paurṇamāsīṃ uttarāṃ vopavased iti pūrvopavāsapakṣe sadyaskālatā nāstīty etadartham idaṃ vacanaṃ, yāvatā dvitīyadine pratipadaḥ pūrvāhṇasya ca vidyamānatvāt punaḥkaraṇaṃ yuktam iti |
analyzed: atra kecid vivadante sa aṅgasya pradhānasya pūrvāhṇe eva kartavya tvāt brāhmaṇa tarpaṇasya ca aṅga tvāt viramya vyāpāre ca aṅga pradhānavatyām bhāvanāyām vidhinā pravartita tvāt tad virodhaḥ vārttika kāraiḥ ca yāvat jīva adhikaraṇe paurṇamāsī atirikta ahar vyavaccheda parā śrutiḥ avyāptau api tadvat syāt na tu iha evam pratīyate iti etad śloka vyākhyāne uktam yadi tatra alpatvāt karmaṇaḥ pūrvāhṇa codanā vaśena paurṇamāsī na vyāpyate na kiṃ

original: tad ayukam | “pratipady apraviṣṭāyām" itivākyasaṃkocaprayaṅgāt prayogavacanākṣiptāṅgapradhānaikakālasya vacanavaśena heyatvāt na tadvaśena [370] saṃkoco yuktaḥ “sandhim abhito yajeta" iti śrutivirodhāc ca | sā hi sandher ubhayato yāgaprayogo yathā bhavati tathā yaveteti pratipādayati | tathāparāhṇādiparvasandhau tadacaḥ prātaranvādhāca pareṣuryāge ’nuṣṭhīyamāne sandhigarbhatā bhavaty evety avirodhaḥ | pūrvāhṇaparvasandhau tu pūrvedyur anvādhāya tadahaḥsandheḥ pratyak samāptau sandhigarbhatvaṃ hīyate tenottamaḥ padārthaḥ samāptiśabdavācyo brāhmaṇatarpaṇātmakaḥ kevalaṃ sandher ūrdhvaṃ utkraṣṭayaḥ, tāvatā prayoge sandhigarbhatā setsyati na tu madhye virāmaḥ kasmāt sandhigarbhaśāstravaśād iti brūmaḥ |
analyzed: tat ayukam pratipadi a praviṣṭāyām iti vākya saṃkoca prayaṅgāt prayoga vacana ākṣipta aṅga pradhāna eka kālasya vacana vaśena heya tvāt na tad vaśena saṃkocaḥ yuktaḥ sandhim abhitas yajeta iti śruti virodhāt ca sā hi sandheḥ ubhayatas yāga prayogaḥ yathā bhavati tathā yaveta iti pratipādayati tathā aparāhṇa ādi parva sandhau tad acaḥ prātar anvādhāt ca pareṣuḥ yāge nuṣṭhīyamāne sandhi garbha tā bhavati eva iti avirodhaḥ pūrvāhṇa parva sandha

original: tad ayuktaṃ | idaṃ hi vacanaṃ darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇapaṭhitaṃ vā anārabhyādhītaṃ vā ubhayathāpi vikṛtiniveśo na sambhavati | na ca vikṛtiviśeṣaprakaraṇapāṭhaḥ sarvavikṛtiviṣayatvam aṅgīkurvatā svīkriyate vidyate vā | na ca sarvavikṛtipāṭhaḥ sambhavati, tena prakṛtiviṣayam etat | na ca tatrāpi sadyaskālatvāpavādaḥ sambhavati, tadabhāve kiṃ pratipadi yāgas tasmin parvaṇi vā, na prathamaḥ evaṃvidhaviṣaye [377] dvitīyadine pratipadddhāv api trimuhūrttādhikadvitīyāsadbhāvena “trimuhūrttā dvitīyā ced" ityādivacanavirodhāt, na vājasaneyimatābhiprāyam idaṃ “trimuhūrttaṃ na karttavyam" iti vacanasya madhyāhnāt prāk parvasandhau pratipadvṛddhau tatra yāgo na kartavyaḥ kiṃ tv anvādhānam evety etadarthapratipādakatvābhāvāt | atha pratipadi trimuhūrttā dvitīyā cety asyaitadvaśena hrāsaviṣayety anena saṃkoca iti nirastam | “agrāhyāḥ ṣaṇmuhūrttāḥ syur" ity api vacanaṃ naitadarthapratipādakaṃ, tasmād evam idaṃ vacanadvayaṃ vyākhyeyaṃ ṣaṇmuhūrttam api yadā caturdaśīdinasambandhi anvādhānena grāhyaṃ yadi dvitīyadine varddhate hrāse tad api grāhyam | anyathā “trimuhūrttā dvitīyā ca" iti vākye candradarśanasāṅganiṣedhavākyavirodhaḥ | evaṃ "trimuhūrtthaṃ na kartavyam" iti vacanāntarāvirodhenānvādhānaviṣayam eva vyākhyeyam |
analyzed: tat ayuktam idam hi vacanam darśa pūrṇamāsa prakaraṇa paṭhitam vā an ārabhya adhītam vā ubhayathā api vikṛti niveśaḥ na sambhavati na ca vikṛti viśeṣa prakaraṇa pāṭhaḥ sarva vikṛti viṣaya tvam aṅgīkurvatā svīkriyate vidyate vā na ca sarva vikṛti pāṭhaḥ sambhavati tena prakṛti viṣayam etat na ca tatra api sadyaskāla tva apavādaḥ sambhavati tad abhāve kim pratipadi yāgaḥ tasmin parvaṇi vā na prathamaḥ evaṃvidha viṣaye dvitīya dine pratipad

analyzed: māsa saṃvatsarāt ṛte iti māsikam sāṃvatsarikam ca varjayitvā vidhiḥ iti arthaḥ evam ca sati aparāhṇa prabhṛtayaḥ prakṛtau upadiśyamānāḥ dharmāḥ brāhmaṇa bhojana ātmakasya nityasya eva upadeśataḥ bhavitum arhanti na anityasya dvija kartṛ kāma śrāddhasya api nitya anitya saṃyoga virodhāt yathā prakṛtau upadiśyamānāḥ dīkṣaṇīya ādayaḥ dharmāḥ nityasya eva agniṣṭoma saṃsthasya jyotiṣṭomasya upadeśataḥ bhavanti na anityasya atirātra
